Finally fixed the bug in my RAG pipeline! Super happy about it.
Slept late and felt tired all day. Skipped the evening study session.
Had a good call with a senior about placements. Feeling motivated.
Spent time with family. Calm and relaxed day.
Worried about the upcoming exams and portfolio work piling up.
Mock interview did not go well. Felt low and doubted myself.
Talked to a friend and felt better. Did a small coding task for confidence.
Submitted two assignments on time. Relieved and proud.

column3: stayed in and read about LLM agents. Peaceful.
cleared my head and planned the next week.
